title: Nat20Api
description: Schema root: every type that crosses the wire. Exported by `export-schema`; not itself sent.

save_proficient.description: Whether the creature is proficient in this saving throw.

spell_slot.description: Spell slot level spent, for spells.

ActionOption.description: One option the actor can take at the pending prompt.

action.description: The engine action id behind the option.

max_targets.description: How many targets `submit` may name: 0 for `none`, `self` and `point`, 1 for `single`.

range_ft.description: Range in feet, when the option has one.

targets.description: Creatures the option can target, with their distance.

variants.description: Variants `submit` must pick from, e.g. a spell's casting level. Empty when none.

AdvantageGrant.description: Advantage or Disadvantage granted to a check, with its reason.

reason.description: The rules reason, logged with the roll, e.g. "Help action from Lia".

AdvantageState.description: Advantage state of a d20 roll.

Against.description: The number a roll was compared with.

hint.description: What the caller can do instead, when the engine knows.

message.description:
One plain sentence written for a model or a human. Never Rust debug output, and never a
number the request's `viewer` may not see (CLAUDE.md Rule 3).

reason.description: Finer reason for `rejected`; absent for other codes.

retryable.description: Whether the same request can succeed after the caller changes its input or waits.

Awaiting.description: Who the engine waits on next, tagged by `kind`.

oneOf.description: A creature may react to a trigger: answer with `react`.
Nothing pending: explore mode, or a session with no scene yet.

Combat ended by itself because a side is down. The scene is already back in explore mode
and nothing is pending: reported until the next command, after which it reads `none`.
Go on with any explore command, `start_combat` or `load_scene`; `end_combat` is not needed.

winner.description: The side left standing, if any.

oneOf.description: A check the scenario defines, with its ability, skill and DC.
A check the DM picks from the SRD DC ladder (5 very easy to 30 nearly impossible).
Every creature on one side is down.
The DM ended it: the other side surrendered.
The DM ended it: the other side fled.

CommandResult.description:
The typed result of each command, tagged by `cmd`.

Variants are struct variants, never newtype variants: schemars renders a tagged newtype variant
as `$ref` plus sibling keywords, which the TS generator drops, losing the tag.

oneOf.description: What the engine says about itself on `hello`.

engine_rev.description: The `nat20_core` revision the engine was built against.

schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of `generated/nat20-api.schema.json`. Clients compare it with the hash they were generated from.

seed.description: The dice seed in use, given or picked.

oneOf.description: The state after the scene loaded.
The actor's options at the pending prompt.

options.description: Options the actor can take now.

prompt_id.description: The prompt these options belong to; echo it in `submit` and `end_turn`.

unavailable.description: Options the actor has but cannot take now, with the reason.

oneOf.description: The option was taken; its rolls and effects are in `events`.
The reaction was taken or declined; its rolls and effects are in `events`.
The turn ended; the next prompt is in `awaiting`.

provoked.description: Creatures that got an opportunity attack prompt from this move, in prompt order.

success.description: Whether the check succeeded. The engine decides, never the caller.

oneOf.description: The group check's rolls and outcome.

roll_ids.description: One roll per actor, in the order given.

success.description: Whether at least half the group succeeded.

oneOf.description: Hit Points regained on the short rest.
The state after initiative, in combat mode.
The state after combat ended, in explore mode.

events.description: Projected for the request's `viewer`. Entries the viewer may not see are left out.

next.description: Pass as `since` to read on from here.

Condition.description: The SRD 5.2.1 conditions (Exhaustion is a level on the sheet, not listed here).

CreatureFull.description: A creature as its owner and the DM see it.

health.description: The health band other players see.

CreatureObserved.description: A creature as another player perceives it. Has no Hit Points, Armor Class or stat block, by design.

distance_ft.description: Distance from the viewer, in feet.

oneOf.description: The SRD DC ladder, picked by the DM.

DiceRolled.description: One group of dice in a roll.

kept.description: The sum the roll kept, after Advantage or Disadvantage.

results.description: Every die's face, including dropped ones.

source.description: What the dice are for, e.g. `d20` or `longsword`.

EndCombatReason.description: Why the DM ends combat early.

oneOf.description: A scenario trigger ends the fight.
Malformed JSON, a missing or wrongly typed field, or an unknown `cmd`.
`v` is not a version this engine speaks.
The command needs a session and none exists.
The command needs a loaded scene and none is loaded.
The creature handle is not in this scene.
The option id is not offered by the current prompt.
The check id is not defined by the scene.
The anchor id is not defined by the scene.
The spawn id is not declared by the scene.
The actor is not the one the engine is waiting on.
The prompt id does not match the pending prompt.
The viewer may not see what it asked for.
A combat command in explore mode, or the reverse.
The engine refused a well-formed decision; see `reason`.
The command is in the contract but this engine build does not implement it yet.
An engine bug. The request did nothing; details go to stderr.

ErrorHint.description: What the caller can do instead of the failed request.

awaiting.description: The pending prompt, e.g. with the current `prompt_id` after `stale_prompt`.

legal_option_ids.description: Option ids the actor can take at the pending prompt.

round.description: The combat round, in combat mode.

scene.description: The scene the event happened in; absent before the first scene loads.

seq.description: Position in the session log, from 1. Unique and monotonic for the whole session.

text.description: One plain sentence rendered for the viewer. Never carries a number the viewer may not see.

mode.description: The mode the scene starts in.

participants.description: Every creature in the fight, in initiative order.

winner.description: The side left standing, if any.

roll.description: The roll, in the view the viewer may see.

oneOf.description: A creature took damage. The amount is said at the table; the Hit Points left are not.

source_roll.description: The damage roll, when one was made.
The healing roll, when one was made.

oneOf.description: A creature's Hit Points changed. DM and owner only.

source.description: What caused it, e.g. a spell or feature id.

anchor.description: The anchor it moved to, when it moved to one.

check_id.description: The scenario check id, for scenario checks.

oneOf.description: Creatures were placed by a spawn.

Handle.description: A creature's handle in the session, e.g. `bren` or `goblin_1`. Stable for the creature's life.

HealthBand.description: Coarse health that every viewer may see. SRD 5.2.1: Bloodied means half Hit Points or fewer.

oneOf.description: Half Hit Points or fewer, above 0.

HitDicePool.description: Hit Point Dice of one size.

HitDiceSpend.description: Hit Point Dice one creature spends on a short rest.

equipped.description: Whether it is equipped or wielded.

id.description: Item id from the registry, e.g. `longsword`.

oneOf.description: At 0 Hit Points, making death saving throws.

Mode.description: Whether the session is out of combat or in initiative order.

oneOf.description: Exploration and social play: no initiative, checks on request.
Initiative order: one actor at a time, reactions interrupt.

Modifier.description: One modifier added to a roll.

source.description: What it comes from, e.g. "Strength" or "Proficiency".

oneOf.description: A named landmark the scene defines, e.g. `millwheel`.

handle.description: The creature to move next to.

OptionId.description:
An action option's id, derived from the action and its context (weapon, spell and level),
never from a list index, e.g. `melee_attack/longsword`. Stable for the life of a prompt.

PointFt.description: A point in feet. The engine works in metres internally and converts at the boundary.

oneOf.description: Expertise: adds twice the Proficiency Bonus.

PromptId.description: A pending decision's id, e.g. `p57`. `submit`, `react` and `end_turn` echo it.

ReactionOption.description: A reaction the actor can take.

ReactionTrigger.description: The event that opened a reaction prompt.

summary.description: One plain sentence, e.g. "goblin_1 moves out of Bren's reach".

oneOf.description: At the start of each turn.
On a Short or Long Rest.

RejectReason.description: Why the engine refused a well-formed decision.

oneOf.description: The target is beyond the option's range.
No creature can be targeted by this option.
The chosen target cannot be targeted by this option.
The actor lacks the resource (slot, use, movement) the option costs.
The action type has already been used this turn.
A condition on the actor prevents the option.
The actor does not know this spell or feature.

Request.description: One request line sent to the engine.

id.description: Client-unique request id. A repeated id returns the stored response and does not execute again.

viewer.description:
Who the response is for: `dm` or a creature handle. Selects the projection of every state,
sheet and event in the response (`contract/protocol.md` §5). A player agent's tools bind it
to that agent's own handle.

oneOf.description: Handshake: protocol name, versions and the schema hash. Clients refuse to start on a hash mismatch.
Starts a session: an empty log and no scene. Replaces any running session.

seed.description:
Dice seed. The same seed and the same request stream give an identical log. When
omitted, the engine picks one and logs it in `session_started`.

oneOf.description: Loads a scene from the scenario and enters explore mode. The party carries over.

party.description:
Creatures carried in from the previous scene, with their HP, resources and conditions.
Empty for the first scene, whose party comes from the scenario.

scene_id.description: Scene id from the scenario file.

oneOf.description: The current state, projected for the request's `viewer`.
A creature's full sheet. Only its owner and `dm` may ask; anyone else gets `not_visible`.

The options the actor can take at the pending action prompt.
Returns `not_your_turn` when the engine is waiting on someone else.

actor.description: The creature whose options are listed.

oneOf.description: Takes one option at the pending action prompt.

option_id.description: One of the option ids `legal_actions` returned for this prompt.

point.description: Target point, for options whose `targeting` is `point`.

prompt_id.description: The pending prompt's id. An old id is rejected with `stale_prompt` and changes nothing.

targets.description: Targets, for options whose `targeting` is `single` or `multiple`.

variant.description: One of the option's `variants`, when it has any (e.g. a spell's casting level).

choice.description: The `choice` of one of the prompt's options, or absent to decline.

oneOf.description: Moves a creature. In combat it spends movement and may provoke opportunity attacks.

prompt_id.description: The pending prompt's id. Required in combat, ignored in explore mode.

oneOf.description: Asks the engine to roll an ability check. The engine rolls and decides success.

actor.description: The creature that makes the check.

advantage.description: Advantage or Disadvantage, always with the rules reason for it.

oneOf.description: A group check from the scenario: succeeds when at least half the group succeeds.

actors.description: The creatures that make the check.

oneOf.description: A short rest. Each participant may spend Hit Point Dice.

hit_dice.description: Hit Point Dice to spend per creature. A creature not listed spends none.

oneOf.description: Rolls initiative and enters combat mode.

surprised.description: Creatures that are surprised (Disadvantage on initiative).

oneOf.description:
Ends combat early, only for a reason the scene allows. A fight that ends by itself (a side
is down) needs no `end_combat`: the scene is already back in explore mode.
Places creatures the scene declares under a spawn id.

spawn_id.description: Spawn id from the scene file.

oneOf.description: Log entries after `since`, projected for the request's `viewer`.

since.description: The `seq` to read after; `0` reads from the start.

Response.description: One response line written by the engine, answering exactly one [`Request`].

awaiting.description: Who the engine waits on next. Never projected away: everyone may know whose turn it is.

error.description: Why the command failed. Set when `ok` is false.

events.description: The log entries this request produced, projected for the request's `viewer`. Empty on error.

id.description: The request id this answers; `null` only when the request line was too malformed to read an id.

log_head.description: The session log length after this request; pass it to `events.since` to read on from here.

ok.description: `true` when the command succeeded and `result` is set; `false` when `error` is set.

result.description: The command's result, tagged by the same `cmd` as the request. Set when `ok` is true.

RollId.description: A roll's id, `r` plus a number, e.g. `r412`. Unique for the whole session, never reused.

oneOf.description: An ability check without a skill.
An ability check with a skill.
An attack hit with a natural 20.
A roll with nothing to compare, such as damage or initiative.
Everything the engine knows about the roll. The audit runs on this view.

against.description: The number the total was compared with, if any.

dc_source.description: Where the DC came from, for checks and saves.

label.description: Short label, e.g. "Longsword attack vs goblin_1".

oneOf.description: What another player sees: the dice, the total and the result.

label.description: Short label, e.g. "Longsword attack vs goblin_1".

Sheet.description: A creature's full sheet. Only its owner and the DM receive it.

abilities.description: The six abilities with their saving throws.

class.description: Class id, e.g. `fighter`. Absent for monsters.

death_saves.description: Death saving throws so far, while unconscious.

features.description: Class, species and background features by name.

hit_dice.description: Hit Point Dice by die size.

species.description: Species id for characters, creature type for monsters.

spell_slots.description: Spell slots by level; empty for non-casters.

Side.description: Which side of a fight a creature is on, as seen by the party.

oneOf.description: The player characters and their allies.

State.description: The session state, projected for the request's `viewer`, tagged by `view`.

oneOf.description: What the DM sees: every creature in full.

initiative.description: Initiative order, in combat mode; empty in explore mode.

round.description: The combat round, in combat mode.

oneOf.description: What one player sees: their own creature in full, the others as observed.

initiative.description: Initiative order, in combat mode; empty in explore mode.

others.description: Every other creature the viewer perceives.

round.description: The combat round, in combat mode.

viewer.description: The creature whose player is looking.

TargetCandidate.description: A creature an option can target.

distance_ft.description: Distance from the actor, in feet.

in_range.description: Whether it is within the option's range now.

UnavailableOption.description: An option the actor has but cannot take now.

Viewer.description: Who a projection is for: `dm`, or the handle of the creature whose player is looking.

Visibility.description: Who may see an event, tagged by `scope`.

oneOf.description: The DM and the player of one creature.

handle.description: The creature whose player may see it.
